name: amm
description: The Open Exchange's SWAP app (shruggr/open-exchange#1; skein-amm's config app 0.22.0, moved and changed, shruggr/skein#164): the instance `swap` that serves the Swap pages and records root's decisions as facts, each emitted as an event the Open Exchange host reacts to; nothing is asked of an instance manager and nothing answers back. swap is born owned by the host's key (root); the first wallet to claim it becomes its admin (0.5.0). The admin's (or root's) messages in the box amm/admin (its route's function `configure` gated by the role admin, granted as amm.admin by the host on the event claimed; root passes anything; the door's kernel.beef checks a BEEF against the host chain, so the chain app is required): {fn: "enable", args: {tokenId: "<txid>_<vout>", beef?}} — the BEEF's subject the token id's transaction and its output <vout> a BRC-162 / BRC-161 deploy, else refused; beef may be left out for a token on the list (its kept deploy) — the row enabled under amm/tokens and the event {event: "token-enabled", tokenId, beef, terms?, market?} (the defaults at that step); {fn: "disable", args: {tokenId}}: the row disabled, the event {event: "token-disabled", tokenId}; {fn: "defaults", args: {terms?: {lpFeeBps, validatorFeeBps, commissionBps} | null, market?: {minCommissionBps} | null}}: the defaults under amm/defaults (partial; null clears one), carried by the next token-enabled events; {fn: "discovery", args: {on: true|false}}: the record {on, since} under amm/discovery and the event discovery-on / discovery-off. The claim, {fn: "claim"} in the box amm/claim (any sender): the first writes amm/claim {claimant, since} and emits {event: "claimed", claimant: <hex>}, answered {fn: "claim", result: {claimant}}; a later one refused (claimed). Each answered to the sender in its box {fn, request, result | error}. Reads (anyone, nothing logged): /tokens, the enable list [{tokenId, topic, sym, dec, icon?, status: enabled|disabled, since}] newest first; /defaults, {terms?, market?}; /discovery, {on, since} (or {on: false}); /admin, {claimant, since} (or {} unclaimed); / the Swap pages (www/); a token's instance is <origin>/@<tokenId>.
